capabilities: Records income and expense operations as Markdown notes
Calculates account balances and moves money between accounts with transfers
Plans yearly expenses with a category-by-month heatmap
Tracks personal debts and links them to repayment plans
Imports and exports all finance data as one Excel workbook
extras: Amounts are shown only in Russian rubles; currency conversion and exchange-rate history are not supported. Interface is Russian and English. The plugin makes no network requests and collects no telemetry. Back up the vault before large category migrations or manual frontmatter edits.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record income, expenses, accounts and transfers, so personal finance records end up in a separate app or spreadsheet.

relations.evidence: through the optional Person Network connector, by a linked person note and photo

summary: Local-first finance tracker that turns Markdown notes with YAML frontmatter into income, expense, account, transfer, debt and planning views.
